notes.content:
1 The "Mirror Maze" spring hidden map has been updated. You can enter it by changing the system time of your computer to between March and May.
2 The boss of the second level has a new skill called "Abandoned Vehicle".

1 The "Mirror Maze" summer hidden map has been updated. You can enter it by changing the system time of your computer to between June and August.
2 The enemy locking function of the right mouse button has been adjusted. When facing multiple enemies, you can freely switch the locked target.
3 A new character function has been added: You can adjust the third-person perspective by using the right mouse button in combination with the mouse scroll wheel.

Added "Pick - up prompt when approaching the equipment".
Added moving sound effects for the Dinosaur Pavilion.
